thread:
Ibrahim (sales): Stratos RFI arrived from their platform team. They want a compact capability matrix, full security questionnaire answers (incl. HSM/BYOK), and three POC pricing scenarios. CRM link: https://crm.redwood/deals/STR-17/rfi.pdf
Carmen (solutions): I'll own the capability matrix and the POC runbook. Suggest POC split: 5d benchmarking, 7d integration, 3d acceptance. Pricing tiers: evaluation hosted, short Dedicated commit (1 month), and Private trial with uplift + install fee.
Leo (eng): Adding performance notes: for 70B-class on Dedicated p50 token latency ~165ms (A100-80GB) at batch=8. Will add measured numbers and guidance on batch/latency tradeoffs. Also flag: customer uses a model with custom CUDA kernels  we'll need to validate operator parity under quantization.
Hannah (security): They require HSM-backed key control and proof of key separation. We can support BYOK via PKCS#11 for on-prem HSMs and cloud HSM integrations for private deployments. I'll draft questionnaire answers and include audit log retention options (30/90/365) and SIEM export methods.
Ibrahim (sales): They also listed GDPR/EU residency for some workloads and stricter egress constraints. Legal will want precise wording on data flows and processing locations.
Carmen (solutions): Runbook checklist items I'll include: connectivity test, sample prompt set for quality validation, rollback plan, and contact list for escalation. I'll attach a sample runbook template to the deal.
upload-bot: Reminder: please upload capability matrix CSV and draft RFI answers to deal folder: https://crm.redwood/deals/STR-17/files
Leo (eng): Quick sample bench config for runbook to paste:
```
model: redwood/70b
profile: perf-benchmark
batch: 8
max_tokens: 256
gpu: A100-80GB
kv_cache: enabled
```
Leo (eng): Also noting a blocker row: "custom CUDA ops under int8 quantization"  engineering needs a repro from the customer to validate. Can we request a small model artifact or op spec?
Hannah (security): I'll mark the questionnaire items that require legal review (data residency, indemnities, export controls). Also: we provide SOC2 Type II reports; FedRAMP not currently in scope.
Ibrahim (sales): Deadline: assembled draft with matrix + security answers by Friday EOD. POC range estimate to buyer by Monday AM. Can the team commit?
Carmen (solutions): Yes, will upload matrix and runbook draft by Thursday COB.
Leo (eng): I'll add benchmark numbers tonight and confirm kernel blocker status by Wednesday.
Hannah (security): Uploading draft answers by Thursday EOD. Will include HSM integration diagram and required network ACLs.
Ibrahim (sales): Great. React :rocket: when you've uploaded your pieces and I'll compile.
Leo (eng): :rocket:
Carmen (solutions): :rocket:
Hannah (security): :rocket:
